description: Read the device's saved benchmark settings (per-page duration, runs, cooldown, reload, shuffle) in plain English with a time estimate. Call this before run_benchmark_batch so you can tell the user what the run will do — run_benchmark_batch inherits these unless you override them.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

pages.description: How many pages/variants you plan to test, for a total-time estimate. Default 1.

name: get_benchmark_settings
